run_nli_evaluation: run the interactive NLI evaluator to classify premise and hypothesis pairs as entailment, neutral, or contradiction
run_pretrained_model: run a pre-trained HuggingFace NLI model like xlnet-large-cased to evaluate natural language inference
evaluate_premise_hypothesis: evaluate a premise and hypothesis pair using the evaluate function with a tokenizer and model
run_interactive_cli: run the interactive CLI loop that prompts for premise and hypothesis input and prints NLI predictions
run_softmax_prediction: run the evaluate function to get softmax probabilities for entailment, neutral, and contradiction labels
